// census-want: 1
// W02-09 Z4 probe: the block function takes a lease, but it is reached
// from a function that runs under none (outside any WalkChain attempt) —
// the closure over the referencing functions finds it.
package oai

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/backends"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/dispatch"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/embed"
)

func (c *call) wireBlock(rc context.Context, b *backends.Backend, lease *dispatch.Lease) error {
	_, _, err := embed.EmbedRaw(rc, *b, "m", c.inputs, 0)
	return err
}

func (c *call) prefetch(ctx context.Context, b *backends.Backend) error {
	return c.wireBlock(ctx, b, nil)
}
